name: Necromancer Touch of Death adds an Expunge stack and 20% Death spell range (#770)
contract: Touch of Death 707113 is a Death talent (CharacterAdvancement 6965, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 59, TalentEssenceCost 1) whose description reads 'Allows Expunge to stack an additional time and increases the range of your Death spells by $s2%.' Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) MiscValue 31 (SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS), BasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = 1, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0x10000000, 0) in SpellFamilyName 29, which matches the Expunge debuff 573233 (family flags 0, 0x10000000, 0; StackAmount 2); SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks leaves nonstacking flag holders (Expunge carriers 500343/500443, Refreshing Chill 800979, Foul Invocation 804371) at zero. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) MiscValue 5 (SPELLMOD_RANGE), BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = 20, EffectSpellClassMask (2, 0x10, 0x2006028), which covers the Death spells Flesh to Worms 500338 (0x4000, 0, 0x20 via word 2 bit 0x20), Crypt Swarm 500965 (0x2, 0, 0) and Blight 500217 (0, 0, 0x2000), all SpellRange 4 = 30 yd; Lichfrost 801722 (0, 0, 0x8000000) is a Rime spell outside the mask. SpellInfo::GetMaxRange applies the caster's SPELLMOD_RANGE, so those Death spells must reach 36 yd while Lichfrost stays at 30 yd, and Expunge must accept 3 stacks instead of 2. The Expunge debuff is cast directly here so the stack cap is observed independently of the Expunge talent's Command trigger.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
CONTROL: Expunge stacks twice without the talent
CONTROL: Flesh to Worms reaches 30 yd
The second Expunge adds a stack
CONTROL: Expunge caps at 2 stacks without the talent
Lichfrost, a Rime spell, keeps 30 yd
The talent lets a third stack land
Expunge caps at 3 stacks with the talent
